Magic Dip
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 11:25pm

Ingredients




1 pkt Cream cheese, softened
1 cup Semi-sweet real chocolate
Chips
1/2 cup Flaked coconut, toasted
1/2 cup Chopped peanuts

Preparation

1 Spread cream cheese on bottom of 9 inch microwavable pie plate or quiche plate. Top with remaining ingredients. Microwave on medium (50%%) 3 to 4 minutes or until warm. Serve with graham crackers. Garnish, if desired. 2 Makes 6 to 8 servings.*Great for kids.ch
